arm_objectives.target_only: native target positive mean + negative mean

denominator: max(n_left+n_right,1) per query; all query rows retained in population means

historical_native_study_context.role: completed native single and independent ensemble context only; not new matched cells or state donors

initialization: each cell fresh make_pattern with own empty native Adam; paired seed, dedicated factor-sign seed, model flags and all RNG. No donor state.

interpretation_rules.VALID_only_development: Collab TEST history is consumed. No TEST path, access, selection or release in this packet.
interpretation_rules.benchmark_requirement: A frozen successor and a competitive official-split second benchmark are required for generalization or methodological claims.
claims_excluded: target-gradient cosine as a predictor of generalization
large numerical distinction under the original derivative rule
interpretation_rules.incomplete_family: Preserve every completed, failed or missing cell; no success-only subset mean or contrasts.
interpretation_rules.joint_beats_target_but_not_separate: Evidence supports auxiliary supervision; no cross-side association advantage. Simplify the claim.
interpretation_rules.neither_auxiliary_improves: Retain all outcomes and close this candidate; no expanded tuning grid.
interpretation_rules.pairing_failure: Preserve all cells/differences, expose mismatched initialization or stream/RNG receipts, and mark paired interpretation ineligible.
interpretation_rules.primary_cross_side_association: joint minus separate over all three paired seed blocks
interpretation_rules.primary_predictive_transfer: joint minus target_only over all three paired seed blocks
interpretation_rules.secondary_auxiliary_supervision: separate minus target_only over all three paired seed blocks
interpretation_rules.uncertainty: All three differences, mean, sample SD, range and signs; descriptive Student-t df2 interval and exact eight sign flips. Minimum nonzero two-sided p is0.25; no graph-level or query-bootstrap generalization claim.

native_recipe: same qualified SharedEncoder/PatternDecoder F4, native Adam learning rates0.0082/0.0037, plain float32
output_visibility: count/time-only live progress; per-epoch metrics and complete selected VALID logits retained locally in own private artifacts for final nine-cell analysis
pairing: same fresh initialization and all100 epoch native negative/permutation/tail/batch/RNG receipts checked across arms; any mismatch disclosed
reuse_qualification: existing complete V5 numerical/fullgraph profile and physical terminal receipts; actual completed exact bucket same-state equivalence. No new gradient or CPU engineering ladder.
seed_selection: first three ordered blocks from the existing frozen native five-block design, before these predictive outcomes
selection: all100 complete VALID strict official shared-pool Hits50 candidates, first exact tie, own full state
serving: private own native completion route, mean of four raw logits, complete TRAIN graph; no teacher or count serving inputs
teacher: complete TRAIN observation membership as detached labels only; unobserved is not a verified latent nonlink
training: complete TRAIN record mask per batch, unchanged default negative sampling once per epoch, unchanged PermIterator and dropped tail; one encoder, positive then negative native member/left/right forwards
